# WinSparkle (headers only in-tree)

Official prebuilt binaries are downloaded by `cmake/WinSparkle.cmake` on Windows
builds (default version **0.8.3**). Headers here are for reference and Linux IDE
browsing; they are not linked on non-Windows.

- Upstream: https://winsparkle.org / https://github.com/vslavik/winsparkle
- License: MIT (see COPYING in the release zip)
